nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Volunteer Opportunities”, thêm siêu liên kết cho chữ “Volunteers receive free” trỏ tới tiêu đề “Places to Play” trong tài liệu này.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Volunteer Opportunities” section, add a hyperlink to the text “Volunteers receive free” that links to the “Places to Play” heading in this document.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn "Volunteers receive free".  2) Insert > Link > Place in This Document.  3) Mở Headings > chọn "Places to Play" > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select "Volunteers receive free".  2) Insert > Link > Place in This Document.  3) Expand Headings > choose "Places to Play" > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Volunteer Opportunities” section, add a hyperlink to the text “Volunteers receive free” that links to the “Places to Play” heading in this document.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Volunteer Opportunities”, thêm chú thích dưới ảnh với nội dung “Figure 1 League illustration”. Không đổi nhãn hay định dạng đánh số.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Volunteer Opportunities” section, add a caption below the picture that reads “Figure 1 League illustration”. Do not change the label or numbering format.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh > References > Insert Caption.  2) Label: Figure; Position: Below selected item.  3) Gõ thêm " League illustration" sau Figure 1 > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the picture > References > Insert Caption.  2) Label: Figure; Position: Below selected item.  3) Type " League illustration" after Figure 1 > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Volunteer Opportunities” section, add a caption below the picture that reads “Figure 1 League illustration”. Do not change the label or numbering format.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De01_P7_Weekdays_Expert.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open De01_P7_Weekdays_Expert.docx and complete the tasks below in order.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Giới hạn định dạng trong tài liệu ở bộ style tối thiểu được đề xuất. Không bật bảo vệ (enforce protection).
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Limit formatting in the document to the recommended minimum set of styles. Do not enforce protection.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > Restrict Editing.  2) Formatting restrictions: tích Limit formatting to a selection of styles > Settings.  3) Bấm Recommended Minimum > OK (chọn No nếu hỏi xoá định dạng không cho phép). Không bấm Start Enforcing Protection.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Review > Restrict Editing.  2) Formatting restrictions: check Limit formatting to a selection of styles > Settings.  3) Click Recommended Minimum > OK (choose No if asked to remove disallowed formatting). Do not click Start Enforcing Protection.

cham.de_bai: Limit formatting in the document to the recommended minimum set of styles. Do not enforce protection.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đặt ngôn ngữ kiểm tra chính tả (proofing language) cho toàn bộ tài liệu là English (United Kingdom).
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Set the proofing language for the entire document to English (United Kingdom).
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Ctrl+A.  2) Review > Language > Set Proofing Language > chọn English (United Kingdom) > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Press Ctrl+A.  2) Review > Language > Set Proofing Language > choose English (United Kingdom) > OK.

cham.de_bai: Set the proofing language for the entire document to English (United Kingdom).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tạo bộ theme fonts tùy chỉnh tên “Weekdays Fonts”, dùng Georgia cho tiêu đề và Verdana cho nội dung.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Create a custom theme font set named “Weekdays Fonts” that uses Georgia as the heading font and Verdana as the body font.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Design > Fonts > Customize Fonts.  2) Heading font: Georgia; Body font: Verdana; Name: Weekdays Fonts > Save.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Design > Fonts > Customize Fonts.  2) Heading font: Georgia; Body font: Verdana; Name: Weekdays Fonts > Save.

cham.de_bai: Create a custom theme font set named “Weekdays Fonts” that uses Georgia as the heading font and Verdana as the body font.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tạo paragraph style mới tên “Info Box” dùng font Georgia, 12 pt, nghiêng, khoảng cách sau đoạn 6 pt. Áp dụng style này cho đoạn văn bắt đầu bằng “Some researchers believe that a relaxing …”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Create a new paragraph style named “Info Box” that uses the Georgia font, 12 pt, italic, with 6 pt of spacing after the paragraph. Apply the style to the paragraph that starts with “Some researchers believe that a relaxing …”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ trong đoạn cần áp dụng.  2) Home > Styles pane (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S) > New Style.  3) Name: Info Box; Style type: Paragraph; Font: Georgia, 12, Italic.  4) Format > Paragraph > Spacing After: 6 pt > OK > OK (style được áp dụng vào đoạn hiện tại).
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor in the target paragraph.  2) Home > Styles pane (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S) > New Style.  3) Name: Info Box; Style type: Paragraph; Font: Georgia, 12, Italic.  4) Format > Paragraph > Spacing After: 6 pt > OK > OK (the style is applied to the current paragraph).

cham.de_bai: Create a new paragraph style named “Info Box” that uses the Georgia font, 12 pt, italic, with 6 pt of spacing after the paragraph. Apply the style to the paragraph that starts with “Some researchers believe that a relaxing …”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Thay mọi chỗ dùng style Heading 3 trong tài liệu bằng style Heading 2.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Replace all instances of the Heading 3 style in the document with the Heading 2 style.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > để trống Find what và Replace with.  2) Đặt con trỏ ở ô Find what > Format > Style > Heading 3 > OK.  3) Đặt con trỏ ở ô Replace with > Format > Style > Heading 2 > OK > Replace All.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > leave Find what and Replace with empty.  2) Put the cursor in Find what > Format > Style > Heading 3 > OK.  3) Put the cursor in Replace with > Format > Style > Heading 2 > OK > Replace All.

cham.de_bai: Replace all instances of the Heading 3 style in the document with the Heading 2 style.
